It is contested by five Munster [[GAA county teams]] ranked 1–5 in the [[2025 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]]. The competition began on 19 April with the [[2026 Munster Senior Hurling Championship final|final]] on 7 June. == Format == === Group stage (10 matches) === Each team plays each other once. The 1st and 2nd placed teams advanc to the Munster SHC final and the 3rd placed team advances to the All-Ireland SHC quarter-finals. === Final (1 match) === The top 2 teams in the group stage contested this game. The Munster champions advanced to the All-Ireland SHC semi-finals and the Munster runners-up advanced to the All-Ireland SHC quarter-finals. == Teams == === General Information === Five counties
